The '''TaggeCo Corporate Facility''' was the headquarters for the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company's]] operations on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. An elaborately designed [[pressure]], the facility supported almost one thousand TaggeCo employees. Facility security was provided by [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]].
